body:
I boiled the datura foilage in about two and on half cups of water until it was black and smelled like a swamp. I poured it into two cups half for now half for later I sipped it down in my room until it was gone and sat on my couch for about an hour.  When I got up to take a piss I realized I could not walk and stagged into the bathroom and urinated and staggered back out.  I tried to go back to my room but I ran into the wall and said 'damn it' thinking it was not real and I was up stairs in the hallway.  I moved around the basement until someone woke up in my house bitched and told me to go to bed.
When I woke up the next morning I was tripping mad balls and watched the tube for god knows how long. I went into the living room and some retarded chick gave me a fortune and I read it.  It was the DO NOT CONSUME sticker from my bag of datura.  I went into my room again and stared into space for along time.
I was smoking the last of my cigarettes.  After I had put them out I thaught I was still holding them so when I brought them down for the final drag they flew out of my hand and into nothing. I saw my friends Dan and nate and decide to talk to them and they said they were leaving to smoke weed.  I did not realize it was friday and they were at school so I went into the living room again to get all of the kids back to the room.  They all disappeared.
I sat in my chair and noticed my covers were in fact a burn victim so I stared at him for awhile and the it was the pseudo dinner everyone from the house gathered around my desk and we at an imaginary dinner. I left my room and sat on the steps and began to read an imaginary book and when I look at my strobe light it became some random friends. I was still fucked up for three days afterward.
